notes.title: 1.111 Release Notes - Minna Alley
notes.notes:
- Doubled standard guild chat history limit to 60 days.
- Fix adventure boards with lots of wizards to line-wrap faces.
- Fix rare problem with seasonal visitors without guest houses.

notes.title: 1.110 Release Notes - Lost in the Shuffle
notes.notes:
Fixes for Fairyland!

- Save your last location longer, even if visiting someone else’s village.
- Improved desktop mode play: labels stay visible and camera zooming works when chat is up.
- Reduce pestering about streak repair, if you’ve already declined that streak.
- Remove outdated fairy news image.

notes.title: 1.108 Release Notes - Scroll Mail
notes.notes:
New Library music and unusual fixes.

- New music in Library spaces.
- Fixed mailbox decor to work better on phones.
- Same with other places where a long list of wizards could be shown, like “Report Player” from Settings.
- Fixed mailbox decor to indicate that it’s interactable.

notes.title: 1.106 Release Notes - Orbital Increment
notes.notes:
Bug fixes and set-up for the next Relic Rally!

- Fix sun/moon/star benches being recognized as benches.
- Fix bug with pockets when using up items near the last page in a tab.

notes.title: 1.104 Release Notes - Bibliophobia
notes.notes:
Turned the page on some small bugs.

- Fix camera during wizard creation.
- Fix server bugs with loading guild spaces.
- Fix bugs related to transmogging.
- Fix some prop items that have “phantom” colors, causing them to not stack.
- Some changes to updating colors in repaintable interiors, let us know if anything looks wrong!

notes.title: 1.102 Release Notes - Cloudkeep Candy Chaos
notes.notes:
Your Castle and Halloween adventures continue, with a few new features:
- Turn off mood lighting in Halloween shop when you’re previewing clothing
- Candy can now be purchased directly for 1 Dazzle (not 3)
- Visible faces on the Prize and Magic Sparks you harvest at Heartwood Trees
- Ghosts go a little easier on intro Halloween adventures
- Small changes to Lovely Gown and Angelic Robe pants

notes.title: 1.101 Release Notes - Cloudkeepoween
notes.notes:
Halloween is back! Collect candy in castles!

The seasonal fun continues:
- Halloween is back! Help your Guild build a haunted house, and venture out into spooky woods.
- Castle is still here! Continue questing for the Queen, from your Guild’s Castle Shoppe.
- A frightfully harrowing choice for October!

- Exfoliant, Deviner, Move Boost & Super Move Boost won’t work if someone is already puzzling.
- Mine All Mine potions can now be used to free items embedded in stones as well as auto-build a bridge from a pile of cobble.
- Fixed castle shrubs to not be so similar to each other.
- Another fix to prevent fams from jumping into unrevealed tiles in ruins spaces.

notes.title: 1.100 Release Notes - Cloudkeep Quixotics
notes.notes:
Fight Nefarious Wizards and their Enchanted Armor in Cloudkeep Chaos! With the latest bug fixes!

- Remove more tap indicators from chairs.
- A new activity icon for when someone is in the bridge harvest puzzle.
- Fixed bug where some players couldn’t start a bridge mix puzzle.
- Remove future decor from workshop. Whoops!
- Fix some bugs with dropping items.
- Castle Fence Span can be placed anywhere, not just outdoors.
- Fix the “-” button on the recipe popup to properly close.

notes.title: 1.99 Release Notes - Cloudkeep Retool
notes.notes:
- Fix tool decor.
- Fix bugs with deleting adventures.

notes.title: 1.98 Release Notes - Cloudkeepin' On!
notes.notes:
Bug fixes for fighting the Nefarious Wizards and decorating your village!

- Fix sizing and centering for some of the new castle decor. You may need to re-place them to adjust their position.
- Fix colliders on rugs so they can be picked-up.
- Fix how many wizards can join large castle battles.
- Fix mixing the Cordial Cordial.

notes.title: 1.97 Release Notes - Cloudkeep Upkeep
notes.notes:
Fight Nefarious Wizards and their Enchanted Armor in Cloudkeep Chaos, now with a few more bug fixes!

The Queen requests your aid defending Cloudkeep against the League of Nefarious Wizards!
- Build a new cottage in your village for a visiting Cloudkeep heiress
- Visit any Guild’s Castle Shoppe to go on questing adventures for The Queen
- Find new furniture, clothing, and palettes! Mix or buy them in the Castle Shoppe, or get loot while adventuring
- Enjoy new puzzle types! New Bridge Building mode for Harvest, new enemy powers in Battle, new cooperative dungeons and maps

And that aid will be easier with these bug fixes!
- When purchasing clothing, you can now select colors
- Dungeons with recipes that need Prize Shards will have Prize Shards
- Fams won’t be left behind when owner wizards enter and exit
- In Battle, big bosses’ health meters will scale correctly
- When starting a party, the button at the tree and the button in the upper right corner will do the same, right thing

notes.title: 1.95 Release Notes - Cloudkeep Chaos
notes.notes:
Fight Nefarious Wizards and their Enchanted Armor in our new Cloudkeep Chaos update!

The Queen requests your aid defending Cloudkeep against the League of Nefarious Wizards!
- Build a new cottage in your village for a visiting Cloudkeep heiress
- Visit any Guild’s Castle Shoppe to go on questing adventures for The Queen
- Find new furniture, clothing, and palettes! Mix or buy them in the Castle Shoppe, or get loot while adventuring
- Enjoy new puzzle types! New Bridge Building mode for Harvest, new enemy powers in Battle, new cooperative dungeons and maps

And we spruced up the place just in time for The Queen’s visit.
- Your Guild islands will now have beautiful themed decorations on turf edges
- Magical artifacts on adventures will show sparkly trail connecting your cause to its effect
- Dazzle is now extra dazzling
- Chairs no longer have tap icons
- Your fams will stop wandering off into locked rooms in ruins
- Lilacleaf will stay lilac at higher elevations, instead of turning green

And a few more functional fixes.
- On adventures, you can no longer throw held items into unreachable spaces
- When mixing a recipe that would require Dazzle, you can’t spend that same Dazzle to revive
- Unaffiliated strangers cannot start fam nests in your village or guild
- Fix an occasional bug when viewing all news from your newsstand
- Fix rare bugs with icons on scrolling lists
- Fix wizards to face overgrown doors when puzzling
- Slightly updated minimum specs for both iOS and Android, due to underlying libraries. We require iOS 13 and Android 7.0.

notes.title: 1.92 Release Notes - Fairyland Disrupted!
notes.notes:
Super tiny bugfixes during the ongoing Fairy event!

- Fix house walls.
- Add revive sounds in Battle.

notes.title: 1.91 Release Notes - Fairyland Disrupted!
notes.notes:
Some additional fixes and tweaks while you save the fairies!

- New settings for managing notifications.
- Guilds with a Level 3 Fairy Shop can now build Fairy Bridges!
- Mixed bridges will now look more bridge-like and less rainbow-like.
- Scroll the social popup if you belong to a lot of guilds.
- Fix being able to remove props near the front of your house.
- Fix a bug that could screw-up a new player logging in from steam.
- Old monument plaques will show the year they were completed.
- Fix door keyholes from casting shadows.

notes.title: 1.90 Release Notes - Fairyland Disrupted!
notes.notes:
Some proper bug fixes to help you save the fairies!

- Fix bugs on the quests popup showing too many fairies to help.
- Fix a loading bug when leaving a party.
- Fix showing the first battle tips if you reset tutorials.
- Fix to hints from showing up after harvest tutorials if they were disabled.
- Fix previewing placing props on top of rugs and roads.
- Fix the Fairy Round Table to not be considered recolorable.
- The Cute Counter Cabinet can now have things set on it.

notes.title: 1.89 Release Notes - Fairyland Disrupted!
notes.notes:
Save the Fairies from the Sologro Bros! Now with extra extras!

Fairyland has been overwhelmed by aggressive agritech Bros, and they need your help!
- Build a comfy sanctuary for the Fairy in your village
- Visit a Guild’s Fairy Shop to start your rescue missions into Fairyland
- Mix or buy new items in the Fairy Shop, or find loot on adventures
- Enjoy new puzzle types! New crops and modes for Harvest, new enemies and pieces for Battle, new cooperative dungeons and maps

With a few extra extras:
- Gathering your adventuring crew together for a traditional Fairy Tea Party
- A few new Fairy palettes and decor available in their shops
- Marked several traditional and recent decor as being unrecolorable
- Winterfest Tables used to come pre-decorated with gifts and tools. If you pick one up now, those trinkets will disappear. But you can now decorate your tabletop with your own trinkets!

notes.title: 1.88 Release Notes - Fairyland Disrupted!
notes.notes:
Save the Fairies from the Sologro Bros! Yet more fixes and updates!

Fairyland has been overwhelmed by aggressive agritech Bros, and they need your help!
- Build a comfy sanctuary for the Fairy in your village
- Visit a Guild’s Fairy Shop to start your rescue missions into Fairyland
- Mix or buy new items in the Fairy Shop, or find loot on adventures
- Enjoy new puzzle types! New crops and modes for Harvest, new enemies and pieces for Battle, new cooperative dungeons and maps

And the following improvements will help you restore Fairyland:
- Collected Bonds will now be sent to your guild upon opening a triple-locked chest
- Fairy turf at the perimeter of your Guild will now have extravagant edges
- Mixing a Fairy Fence recipe in the shop now gets you two fences
- Clearer map icons for bombs and bombables
- Map icon for bomb bean plant disappears when there’s nothing left to bomb
- Map icon for rebuilt Fairy House disappears after you’ve looted it
- When building “Grandma’s Hedge Garden” for your Fairy visitor, the props still have to be close together, but are now allowed to be a little more spaced out
- Adjusted the Wave spell somewhat

notes.title: 1.87 Release Notes - Fairyland Disrupted!
notes.notes:
Save the Fairies from the Sologro Bros! Even more fixes and updates!

Fairyland has been overwhelmed by aggressive agritech Bros, and they need your help!
- Build a comfy sanctuary for the Fairy in your village
- Visit a Guild’s Fairy Shop to start your rescue missions into Fairyland
- Mix or buy new items in the Fairy Shop, or find loot on adventures
- Enjoy new puzzle types! New crops and modes for Harvest, new enemies and pieces for Battle, new cooperative dungeons and maps

But also
- Dazzle Shop
- Fairy Turf can now be mixed at your guild cauldron, if you’ve built a Fairy Shop
- And more assorted bug fixes for Fairy adventures

notes.title: 1.86 Release Notes - Fairyland Disrupted!
notes.notes:
Save the Fairies from the Sologro Bros! With the latest bug fixes.

Fairyland has been overwhelmed by aggressive agritech Bros, and they need your help!
- Build a comfy sanctuary for the Fairy in your village
- Visit a Guild’s Fairy Shop to start your rescue missions into Fairyland
- Mix or buy new items in the Fairy Shop, or find loot on adventures
- Enjoy new puzzle types! New crops and modes for Harvest, new enemies and pieces for Battle, new cooperative dungeons and maps

A few bug fixes will help you restore Fairyland:
- The Tale Teller in your guild will now accept recipes, although you can still put recipes straight into books
- The quest summary button will be clearer about whether decor quests are indoors or outdoors
- Decor that counts as “plants” for quests will now have a plant icon, like other furniture does
- On adventures, Fairy houses are no longer identified with treasure chest icons (too exploitative) and ruined houses are no longer identified with egg icons (too bizarre)
- Bombed machinery loses its “point of interest” map indicator after you’ve blown it up
- Lurking cornerstones gain a “point of interest” map indicator

notes.title: 1.85 Release Notes - Fairyland Disrupted!
notes.notes:
Save the Fairies from the Sologro Bros!

Fairyland has been overtaken by tech bros, and they need your help!
- Help a new visitor in your village (once you’ve rescued all other villagers) and build them a comfy sanctuary
- Discover the Fairy Shop in your Guild and its portal to thrilling adventures
- New furniture, apparel, palettes, and spells can be purchased instantly with Dazzle from the Guild shop, or found as loot
- Bros bring new crops and puzzle modes for Harvest, and new pieces and attacks for Battle

Other features and bug fixes:
- Mixing, mining, and harvesting wizards will now look a little busier
- News won’t constantly show you things you already know
- Rooms in guest houses can be recolored
- Fix mixing the “Work Sink” ceramic item
- Fix “at most 0 players” tooltip
- Fix animal bodies showing up in mix if playing with a transmog’d wizard

notes.title: 1.84 Release Notes - Can I Pet That Fam!?
notes.notes:
Keep petting your fams with bug fixes.

- Tile floors, tables, and sinks available in your Workshop
- Some preparation for next week’s Relic Rally, the Mane Event
- Perhaps even some preparation for Fairy adventures
- Bug fixes: Fixed walls in ruins
- Bug fixes: Fixed previewing apparel before a mix

notes.title: 1.83 Release Notes - Can I Pet That Fam?
notes.notes:
Pet your fams, and any fam! Many adventure and guild improvements, too.

- Many behind-the-scenes changes and improvements.
- Pet a fam when you tap to inspect it.
- Highlight rare items when you pick them up.
- Adventures no longer stay connected to the outdoors chat back in the village or guild.
- Only Ministers and above can arrange decor in a guild space.
- Only Fellows and above can harvest a crop outdoors in a guild.
- Some updates to the guild popup.
- Chests were “given the once-over”.

notes.title: 1.82 Release Notes - Jolly Good Fellows
notes.notes: Academies are open to new players, and bug fixes!

notes.title: 1.81 Release Notes - Jolly Good Fellows
notes.notes:
What's New: New Guild Ranks and Wizard Moderations!

New Guild Ranks:
- Added a new lowest rank, “Apprentice”. New members start at Apprentice.
- Apprentices can read Guild chat but cannot speak up. They cannot rearrange Guild decor.
- The “Member” rank has been renamed to “Fellow”.
- Ministers and above can promote Apprentices to Fellows. Nobody can be demoted to Apprentice.

Other changes:
- You can mute other players to silence their chats.
- Chat “read” stamps are synchronized to your account now instead of the device you play on. There may be an adjustment period while things sync-up.
- New starter Wands, available in your Wandery and an Academy.
- Simpler recipes for the five Basic Palettes at Level 1.
- You and your villagers can now recline in beds!
- The prop details pop-up now includes an icon to tell you if a prop satisfies your gardeners’ desire for an “edge”, a “chair”, or any other category.

Bug fixes:
- Your Winterfest villager will stop confusing your Heartwood for their front door.
- Fix Guild Policy menu sometimes not updating policy.
- Extra stability when large Guilds run many small adventures.
- Puzzle Tutorial popups should be properly bounded.

notes.title: 1.80 Release Notes - Lunar Love Eclipse
notes.notes:
March forth to new frontiers with fresh Relic Rallies

- Last chance for Lunar Love items! The shop closes on March 7.
- Added a drag target for putting items back in pockets.
- Better positioning when you leave a building.
- Adventures will start remembering their starting space for proper returns.
- Adventure board updates for special loot quests.

notes.title: 1.79 Release Notes
notes.notes: Just a quick fix for an issue within logon news.

notes.title: 1.78 Release Notes - Lunar Love Waning
notes.notes:
- If a mix is canceled, the ingredients will drop locked to each wizard that contributed them.
- New map icon for monuments in your guild.
- Fix chat unread indicators.
- Fix showing logon news.

notes.title: 1.76 Release Notes - Lunar Love Waxing
notes.notes:
The Lunar Love contests continue with a few quick fixes:
- Bouquets can now be picked up and recolored
- Lovely Gown recipe can now be mixed
- Correctly display that a Lunar Love prop mixed in a Tavern will go to the mixing wizard
- Props bought at a cash register will have the right colors
- Problems with village gardeners’ Huts sales also fixed
- Some props are now sorted differently in inventory

notes.title: 1.75 Release Notes - Lunar Love
notes.notes:
Join our Lunar Love celebration all month long!

Relic Rallies return with Lunar Love loot!
- New palettes, clothes, and decor — plus a new Love Dragon fam
- An extra-long Rally for all of February with extra loot and prizes
- Join relic adventures with a Guild to build their Monument and climb the leaderboard
- Unlock and mix over 20 new Lunar Love recipes in a Guild’s Tavern all month long, or buy items directly in a Tavern

New item type: Spells
- Add a little magic to the world with one-time use Spells
- Lunar Love brings 3 kinds of Spells in 7 new colors, as adventure loot or for sale in a Tavern
- Stored in your inventory along with your Wands

And also…
- All palette potion mixes will yield 3 potions, regardless of the palette’s tier
- Improvements to palette ordering

notes.title: 1.74 Release Notes - Setting the Table
notes.notes:
[b]Amazing new decorating options![/b]

- Most decor can now be placed atop table decor! To remove the table everything on top must be removed first.
- Most square-shaped decor can now be rotated diagonally, 8 different ways instead of just 4!
- House and Guild Tavern interiors can now be recolored separately from the exterior, houses can be recolored room-by-room.
- 5 new hair styles have been added. Use a beautification tonic to try!
- Building interiors have a new starry backdrop.

Minor updates and fixes:
- Improved scrolling performance of the chat channels panel.
- Renamed Snow Spell to Enchanted Snow Globe.

notes.title: 1.73 Release Notes - Wizards of Winterfest
notes.notes:
- Fix problems with “available to buy” showing up in the wrong places
- Fix problems choosing recipes in certain shops.

notes.title: 1.72 Release Notes - Wizards of Winterfest
notes.notes:
Winterfest recipe fixes:
- Anyone receiving a recipe as loot will also receive an item for personal use
- Stocking Hat is now properly mixable in Winterfest Shops
- Festive Barrel recipe now findable on Winterfest adventures
- Winterfest loot no longer awards Gold Bow Recipes, just awards Gold Bow Palettes
- Recipes, items, and mixes now show the correct end dates, Jan 7 and Jan 14, unaffected by local time zones. (We’ll flip to counting days and hours as the deadlines draw nearer!)
- Recipe books clearly state if an item will become guild property or go a mixing wizard
- Recipe books will show if an item can be bought at the cash register, including in your own village
- When you drop a duplicate recipe on a recipe book, the recipe will be returned to you
- For items that are mixed in a guild building, fixed the tips that incorrectly named their mixery

Other fixes:
- Adjusted the difficulty of Star Ghosts’ ice attacks
- Softened the voices of the Goat, Hedgehog, and Sloth villagers
- Visual tweaks to Winterfest Fireplace

notes.title: 1.71 Release Notes - Wizards of Winterfest
notes.notes:
Winterfest is here! Gather Jingle in charming snowy woods and make your village merrier!

- All the wonderful wizardry of Winterfest, as described in the last release!
- All the delightful deals for Dazzle, as described in the last release!

Plus:
- Fixed clientside display of some Winterfest item costs.
- Fixed clientside display of Winterfest recipe items’ expiry.
- Fixed cat & rat fams from constantly running.
- Fixed the fireplace in the character creation interface.
- Fixed recipe item coloration.

notes.title: 1.70 Release Notes - Winterfest!
notes.notes:
Winterfest is here! Gather Jingle in charming snowy woods and make your village merrier!

Introducing seasonal adventures for Winterfest, and permanent ways to earn Dazzle just by playing!

Winterfest:
- Seek out a special visitor in your village (after rescuing all other villagers) and build them a festive home!
- Discover the Winterfest Shop in your Guild and its portal to Winterfest adventures! Earn recipes, Jingle and special Winterfest loot.
- All Winterfest items can be purchased instantly with Dazzle from the shop. Some Winterfest items require Dazzle to mix.
- Winterfest adventures will run until 11:59 PT Jan 7 with another week to spend Jingle until 11:59 PT Jan 14.
- The Winterfest shop will depart after Jan 14 and return next year.
- Monuments will be paused until mid-January, after the current Fish Legends Rally ends Dec 10.

Dazzle: players can now receive Dazzle as gifts:
- Make a new friend! When a new player makes their first friend, both players will earn Dazzle.
- Join a Guild! A player earns Dazzle when they join their first Guild.
- Enable notifications! And earn Dazzle that way, too.

notes.title: 1.69 Release Notes - Winterfest is Coming
notes.notes:
Teammate battle board snapshots will reflect more status effects than just char.

- Adventures that used to cost 1 mana are now free!
- New music mixes in villages and guilds.
- Show all status effects on board snapshots in battle, as char.
- Fixed buggy awarding of the join-your-first-guild achievement.
- Turf Remover is now 20 coins.
- Fireplace can now be recolored.

notes.title: 1.68 Release Notes - Decorous Drags
notes.notes:
Redecorating your village is more fun with performance improvements!

- Performance improvements when placing decor or revealing new turf.
- A Turf Remover can be bought at gardener huts to delete turf at home or in your guild.

notes.title: 1.67 Release Notes - It's another Knock-Out!
notes.notes:
Multiplayer Mixes advance everyone together to new phases.

- Players will all advance together in multiplayer mixes.
- Fix recipe popup to not show options to buy expired items.
- Clean-up bond news in guilds.
- Add relic news in guilds.
- Performance improvements when viewing many faces.
- Show recently-visited realms on the adventure board.
- Allow players to unpin broken recipes from quests.

notes.title: 1.66 Release Notes - It's a Knock-Out!
notes.notes:
Get back into the fight with a barrage of Battle improvements!

Battle improvements:
- Players that leave a battle will be shown as knocked-out to other players.
- Re-entering players will now see the reviving interface.
- Tweaked battle difficulty. Let us know what you think in the Discord feedback forum.

Other improvements:
- Turf Reseeder is now for sale in village huts.
- Tavern mixing station will make proper splooshing sounds.
- Old adventures can be deleted from the adventure board to clean-up your list.
- Fixed a bug that could cause a space to never finish loading.

notes.title: 1.65 Release Notes - Crisp Dawn
notes.notes:
Witch Fams settle-in for harvest time as Adventures continue and wee bugs are fixed.

Wee bugs:
- Fixed recipe details that had disappeared from the popup.
- Battle “no moves” detection works with ice and vines.
- An existing solo adventure in a particular theme won’t block you from creating more in that theme.

Wee-er bugs:
- More improvements to item sorting: fam eggs and fam food.
- You can no longer pin some unmixable apparel to your quests.
- Improvements to booting a player from parties.
- Turf Raiser and Lowerer now only works in your own spaces, and only outdoors.

notes.title: 1.64 Release Notes - Tangled Webs
notes.notes:
Explore Spooky Halloween Woods & More Relic Rallies!

- Witch fam maps now available in guild towers!
- New tab in inventory to show adventure items, like spark seeds. Guild furniture tab removed when on adventures.
- Adjust scaling for Linux and other desktop users with small screens.
- Add Monuments to the point of interest map.
- Iron before Clay, can’t go astray. Also changed sorting of mana, turf, tickets and others.
- Fix decor that wasn’t boxing-up correctly when dropped on the ground.
- Fix unneeded confirmation when putting palette potions in some storage.
- Fix for big adventure parties with too many floor buttons
- Fix news panel from showing “Day 0”.
- Fix workshop doors on iOS.
- Nix Fairy mana from being awarded from leftover Fairy Flowers.
- More aggressive notification of other players when you start an adventure.
- A variety of wee beautifications and enhancements.

notes.title: 1.63 - Behind the Screams
notes.notes:
- Fixed streak-ending game crash on mighty home Heartwood moves
- Adventures have slightly more Halloween decorations
- Fix layout issues with logon news popup on large or small screens
- Fix raven mouths.
- Many other things that go bump in the app.

notes.title: 1.62 - Sweet Re-Release
notes.notes:
Explore spooky Halloween Woods in October!

Halloween has come to Puzzle Wizards and all of the wilds are all spooky. Earn Candy on Sun, Moon and Star adventures and undertake special Halloween adventures, available from your home and guild heartwood trees, to earn bonus candy and rare Halloween theme items. Candy can be used until November 8 to craft special Halloween props, palettes and costumes in village shops! Enjoy your Samhain spookiness!

- foods are available for the new fams
- fix spending bonds
- improve performance of woods reveals, especially halloween
- fix chat scrolling
- carousel of news items viewable from podium

notes.title: Release Notes 1.61 - Sweet Release
notes.notes:
Explore spooky Halloween Woods in October!

Halloween has come to Puzzle Wizards and all of the wilds are all spooky. Earn Candy on Sun, Moon and Star adventures and undertake special Halloween adventures, available from your home and guild heartwood trees, to earn bonus candy and rare Halloween theme items. Candy can be used until November 8 to craft special Halloween props, palettes and costumes in village shops! Enjoy your Samhain spookiness!

Other features:
- News and announcements when you log in
- Drag Spark Seeds from the sky into their mixes
- Decorate your guild tower’s interiors 

Bug fixes:
- Campfire decor is not recolorable
- Chat channels should re-load after a disconnect
- Fix some harvest primers from forcing-on hint mode after showing
- Many other small fixes and tweaks

notes.title: 1.60 Release Notes - Monumental Party
notes.notes:
Relic Rallies Released! Watch for a special visitor in your Guild!

Features
- Rugs and other floor props can be recolored to really tie the room together.
- Storage props can be recolored.
- Wands will stay equipped.
- Sing emotes will now match the wizard’s voice.

Bug Fixes
- Fix the overgrown door tutorial from repeating.
- Don’t spend a palette to recolor a prop to its current color.

notes.title: 1.59 Release Notes - Symbolic Victory
notes.notes:
Emojis are now available in chat.

- Emojis added for use in chat.
- Large-screen devices running the game in landscape can keep chat windows up.
- Items that come out of mail can no longer be picked-up by other wizards.
- Flinging dozens of items to a building site should complete faster.
- Fix bugs with filling-in more pieces in Heartwood Harvests.
- Village Hattery chest is now for hats, not robes.

notes.title: 1.58 Release Notes - Higgledy-Prim
notes.notes:
Maps in big houses, new craftable benches, and better guild inspection.

- Once a house is larger than 1 square you can zoom out to the map.
- New craftable benches.
- Heartwood harvest streaks will now be aligned with your midnight.
- Props will indicate on their tooltip if they're recolorable.
- Again fix puzzle icons on party players. With _feeling_.
- The Join Guild Popup can now be used to view information about a guild by clicking the icon.

notes.title: 1.57 Release Notes - Found in the Shuffle
notes.notes:
Your home Heartwood will always drop a spark.

- Revamped home Heartwood Harvests:
  - In your own village, you always start with a spark to drop.
  - In friends' villages, you'll drop only coins to earn a spark bonus.
  - Adjusted the rewards you get for dropping all items.
  - Clearly announce the number of items you need to drop.
- Woods heartwoods return to having fewer colors on the board.
- Villager chat logs no longer appear in guild chat.
- Added a variety of outdoor songs.
- Speech bubbles no longer make labels disappear for a while.
- Fam walk speed changes as the fam grows.
- Fix puzzle indicators on party faces.
- Add a Join a Guild interface for new players.

notes.title: 1.56 Release Notes - Liquid Containment
notes.notes:
Curvy roads, contained liquids, and more coins from your heartwood!

- Curvy road props can now be unlocked at your workshop.
- Home Heartwood trees use a new progressive game mode that provides increasing challenge and increasing rewards.
- Unopened doors will be labeled on the map with point-of-interest icons.
- Villager dialog will appear in the chat log.
- Allow more forest to be cleared around your home heartwood.
- The blue liquid in the Star Hut won’t drift out of its jar.

notes.title: 1.55 Release Notes - Ripe Bits
notes.notes:
- Fams start small and get larger as they level up.
- New Point-of-Interest icons added to the map view.
- Fixed connection error when logging into Steam.
- An august group of bug fixes, majestically applied.

notes.title: 1.54 Release Notes - Crepuscular Conundrum
notes.notes:
What's new: Statue Adventures are available in Guild Towers!

- All the fixes from last time: again but with *feeling*.
- Fix Android notications to clear when app is launched.

notes.title: 1.53 Release Notes - Crepuscular Conundrum
notes.notes:
- Statue adventures now available at the Guild Tower ticket tables.
- Hopefully fixed Pixel 7 problems with the game.
- Dropped items that are locked to other players will get cleared from your village
  or guild space, eventually.
- Inventory chests in houses are no longer recolorable, so now you can store your palettes.
- Removed cloth types from hattery. Mix them at the tailor.
- No longer advertising taverns from guilds that are "Closed".
- Fixed line drawing in mixing during another player's attack.
- Fixed editing of guild messages.
- Fixed drag-n-drop items sometimes getting stuck on screen.
- Fixed fence posts from appearing on a tile with a different elevation.
- Fixed mail notification to show sender face.

notes.title: 1.52 Release Notes - Squeaky Squishes
notes.notes:
- Added three new Battle Wands: Scrubber, Weed Whacker and Deicer.
- Added support for "open" Guilds, which allow anyone to join, no invitation needed.
- Added more SFX to battle. Zap, swoosh, boom!
- Only Guild members can start mixes in a Guild. Non-members can still join and help.
- Only the Village owner can start a mix in a Village. Other wizards can join in and help.
- Many bug fixes and other small improvements.

notes.title: 1.51 Release Notes - Squishy Squeaks
notes.notes:
- Adventure maps now for sale in Guild Towers.
- Parties should do a better job of remembering your desired policy.
- Added UI for asking to be invited into a Guild. These requests go to the Guild "Greeter".
- Quick chat no longer blocks access to the main UI buttons.
- Many many bug fixes and small improvements.

notes.title: 1.49 Release - Still Secular Solstice
notes.notes:
- Fixed a problem with recovering cornerstones from ruins.
- Added a potion that automatically clears foliage from blocked doors.
- Fixed problem with squished world view when in a puzzle.

notes.title: 1.48 Release Notes - Secular Solstice
notes.notes:
- Added a preview of your wizard wearing the hat or robe when crafting a new hat or robe. Drag palette potions onto the ingredient list to try different colors before you mix.
- Added your current Spark Streak status to your Wizard popup.
- Added the ability to use Revive potions in Battle.
- Added the ability to use Dazzle to revive in Mixing and Battle.
- Added a graphical indication that pieces can only slide horizontally to Battle.
- Many other small tweaks, fixes and improvements.

notes.title: 1.47 Release Notes - Two Wizards Walk into a Tavern
notes.notes:
- Taverns: Guilds can build a new Tavern building. Pull up a chair and have some tea or stoutrootbeer! Inside the Tavern you can also make some new decor and palette potions.
- Bonds: Adventures that are started from a Guild will now earn Bonds for that Guild. When more than one player participates in a puzzle on those adventures, Bonds will be awarded when it's completed. Bonds are needed to construct buildings in your Guild and to craft the new Tavern Props.
- Knots are now just called Coins. Would a rose by any other name smell as sweet?
- Cornerstones for moving buildings are now purchased in each building. Except your House which is still purchased at the Workshop.
- Harvests in guild spaces should now show up in the news.
- Viewing upgrade progress inside a shop should correctly report Heartwood growth limits.
- Expansions to your village or guild space are now added to the news.
- Many bug fixes and smaller tweaks and improvements.

notes.title: 1.46 Release Notes - Morning Glory
notes.notes:
- Fam food ingredients can now be stored in Bakery box.
- Fixed bug where furni would get recolored when rearranging house walls.
- Harvesting a spark from a fruiting village Heartwood should now count toward your streak.
- Many other small bug fixes.

notes.title: 1.44 Release Notes - Sit a Third Spell
notes.notes: - Fixed a whole buncha bugs that crept into the last update.

notes.title: 1.43 Release Notes - Sit Another Spell
notes.notes:
- Added new Spark Streak system: for every consecutive day you find a Spark you earn new emotes and other rewards.
- Option to start a new adventure is always shown in your Village.
- Faces of your friends now have a heart icon on them when you see them on the adventure panel and in other places in the UI.
- You can now tap anywhere outside a popup to dismiss it. Except for a small number of popups that need to stick around while you interact with the world (like your inventory).
- Fixed many bugs. There are always so many!

notes.title: 1.42 Release Notes - Sit a Spell
notes.notes:
- Removed the day/night sequence from the Woods.
- New end of clearing sequence: sit at the campfire for a spell to reveal the new clearing.
- When your wizard is sitting, the quick chat UI is popped up to make it easy to chat, even on mobile.
- Difficulty retuning for Mixing: ingredients have lower HP and do less damage across the board.
- Difficulty retuning for Harvest: Basic crops and lodes have one fewer piece color, the board is shorter for Basic and Prize crops and lodes.
- Fixed many more bugs.

notes.title: 1.41 Release Notes - Dawn Patrol
notes.notes:
- Taught Fams how to stand on plates in ruins. But they only do it if there aren't enough Wizards to get the job done.
- More streamlining of the new user experience, and improvements to the puzzle tutorials.
- Puzzle hint settings are now synced based on your account rather than the device you use to play.
- Added ability to set your party message when starting an adventure in an Order Tower.
- Fixed so many bugs. But not all of them! We're still fixing. Probably added a few new ones too.

notes.title: 1.40 Update - Flippin' Spatulas!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added a "party message" which can be set from the Party popup. This is shown to players that join the party and is also visible on the Adventure popup when looking for a party to join.
[*] When a Rite of Clearing is completed, another Spark is dropped, like for the Heartwood Seeds.
[*] All crops harvested and lodes mined in Woods and Wilds are now tagged as owned by the harvester, no one else can pick them up.
[*] Wizards no longer drop held items when jumping over rivers.
[*] Retuned the recipes for keys in ruins as well as some of the more widely used ingredients.
[*] Rearranged the music a bit. We're still fiddling around on that front.
[*] Many many small bug fixes and UI tweaks.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.39 Update - Sunrise Salutations
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Battles now have animated opponents instead of boring old snapshots.
[*] Added new party policy modes: "Guild" and "Leader's Friends".
[*] Improved the usability of the puzzle move hinter so that it gets out of your way better. And also added the ability to turn it off entirely on the puzzle pause popup.
[*] Sparks are now found inside "Spark Pods" instead of treasure chests.
[*] Changed the "item in stone" puzzles to be a bit more diverse. In Inner Woods they use small boulders, in Middle Woods they use big boulders and in Outer Woods they use hard boulders.
[*] Added Achievements system and many many initial achievements. Check your Wizard Info popup to see all of your achievements. These achievements will by synced to Steam for players playing via the Steam client.
[*] Added side loot to above-ground Wildwoods clearing scenarios.
[*] Added permanent "tappable" indicators to most things in the world. They start out large to clearly show what is interactive and then get smaller as you play the game longer so that they are less obtrusive once you are experienced.
[*] More improvements to the puzzle tutorials and new new user experience.
[*] Split up the process of going deeper into the Woods. Now when you complete the Rites of Clearing, the portal home is revealed and a "Heartwood Ring" is also revealed. Anyone who wants to head home can do so then, and the players that are going deeper into the Woods must all stand on the Heartwood Ring to reveal the next clearing.
[*] Fixed issue with Stundown being required for Rites of Clearing.
[*] Fixed problem with non-realm owners adding Spark Seeds to the Rite of Clearing mix.
[/list]
